_: Golden for the fi.energiavirasto-2026 preset — D2 §9 1 and 8, D9 §3. Every number carries its source.

sources.grammar: Energiavirasto's määräys, in force 2026-02-02 (energiavirasto.fi, "Sähkön siirtolaskutukseen valmistellaan muutoksia – tehomaksu tasaamaan kulutusta", read 2026-09-19): the tehomaksu starts where the 60-minute average power exceeds an eight-kilowatt threshold. HLD §8's FI row: (60, all, per_day=all, max, month, Linear(free_kw=8)).
sources.free_kw: 8 kW, set by the määräys. An earlier draft circulated at 5 kW; 8 is what came into force.
sources.price: ASSUMED. Energiavirasto sets the structure, not the price: each DSO picks its own unit price, so 2.50 EUR/kW/month is the figure D2 §9 8 and the WP0.3 inline test use, not a published one. Replaced by the site's own DSO price list.
sources.month: Constructed, not measured: four hours in March 2026, one per week, the highest 9.40 kW. March is wholly inside the version (valid_from 2026-02-02) and before the 2026-03-29 DST change.
sources.metric_kw: per_day = all with per_period = max is the single highest hour of the month: max(6.2, 9.4, 8.0, 7.1) = 9.40 kW.
sources.fee: billable = max(9.40 − 8.00, 0) = 1.40 kW; 1.40 × 2.50 = 3.50 EUR for the month.
sources.deductible: D2 §9 8's two cases on the file: a month topping out at 7.0 kW is below the deductible and pays nothing; one at 9.0 kW pays for exactly one kW, 2.50 EUR.

deductible.why: below the 8 kW deductible, so the tehomaksu is nothing at all
exactly at the threshold: the deductible is subtracted, not a trigger
one kW over, one kW billed
